_comment: Source of truth for third-party components. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/ci/check_third_party.py --render. Allowed licences are defined in ADR-0010.

components.name: GoogleTest
components.purpose: C++ unit tests for the native core (host only, not shipped in the app)

components.name: numpy
components.purpose: Python benchmark tools (tools/corpus, tools/s4); development only

components.name: python-soundfile
components.purpose: WAV reading and writing in the benchmark tools; development only (uses libsndfile, LGPL-2.1)

components.name: sherpa-onnx (Python)
components.purpose: Keyword-spotting engine and text-to-speech runtime for the S4 screening

components.name: SentencePiece
components.purpose: Tokenises typed names into the keyword model's BPE pieces in the benchmark tools

components.name: sherpa-onnx KWS zipformer gigaspeech 3.3M
components.purpose: Candidate C1 keyword-spotting model, screening only. Model card says Apache-2.0; the terms of its GigaSpeech training data are unverified, so it must be checked before it is bundled in the app

components.name: Kokoro multi-lang v1.0 (sherpa-onnx build)
components.purpose: Synthetic voices that generate the benchmark's test audio; never shipped

components.name: Silero VAD
components.purpose: Voice-activity model for the duty-cycle measurement; a candidate stage 1 of the pipeline

components.name: Project Gutenberg texts (NLTK data packaging)
components.purpose: Public-domain book sentences spoken by the synthetic talkers in benchmark scenes

components.name: sherpa-onnx streaming zipformer en 20M
components.purpose: Candidate C4: small streaming recogniser with hotword boosting, screening only. Model card says Apache-2.0 and links an icefall LibriSpeech model

components.name: sherpa-onnx streaming zipformer en 70M
components.purpose: Candidate C4: larger streaming recogniser with hotword boosting, screening only; also provides the BPE model. Model card says Apache-2.0 and links an icefall LibriSpeech model

components.name: jellyfish
components.purpose: Metaphone keys for phonetic name matching in the S4 benchmark tools; development only

components.name: Jetpack Compose UI, Foundation and Runtime (BOM 2026.06.01)
components.purpose: Screens of the app (onboarding, home, settings). Versions are pinned through the Compose BOM; checked 2026-10-21 that the Maven POM and the AAR metadata need compileSdk 35 or lower.

components.name: Jetpack Compose Material 3 (BOM 2026.06.01)
components.purpose: Buttons, text fields, cards and theming for the screens.

components.name: AndroidX Activity Compose
components.purpose: Hosts the Compose UI, edge-to-edge drawing, back handling and the permission request launcher.

components.name: AndroidX Lifecycle Runtime Compose
components.purpose: Collects the listening status only while a screen is visible, so the level meter does not run in the background.

components.name: AndroidX Core
components.purpose: ServiceCompat, NotificationCompat, ContextCompat and ActivityCompat: version differences for the foreground service, notifications and permission checks.

components.name: AndroidX DataStore Preferences
components.purpose: Stores the user's name and setup progress on the device (Settings default in docs/plan/03-architecture.md).

components.name: Kotlin standard library and kotlinx.coroutines (transitive)
components.purpose: Pulled in by the AndroidX libraries above and by the Kotlin compiler; control-plane coroutines and the settings flow.

rejected.name: openWakeWord pretrained models
rejected.reason: Non-commercial and share-alike terms conflict with the project's licensing constraints (docs/plan/02-platform-facts.md, P28). The openWakeWord code may still be used to train our own models.

rejected.name: Picovoice Porcupine
rejected.reason: Requires an access key validated online; excluded by the offline and open-source constraints (P30, prior knowledge, not re-verified).
